quote: In February 2025, Genera PR and Tesla entered a contract for the installation of Megapacks at the Cambalache (Arecibo), Vega Baja, Palo Seco (Toa Baja), Yabucoa (Humacao), Aguirre (Salinas), and Costa Sur (Guayanilla) power plants, adding a total of 430 MW of energy storage capacity… The total federal investment for the island-wide project amounts to $767 million
